topic: Verification of ISS-2534/2535 self-applied: §1.6 added to Tier-1 list, κ standardized 1.672→1.677 in part1

holes_found.description: ISS-2535 partial landing: decider updated the §1.6 TLDR (κ = 1.677 nT/μGal present) but missed two body occurrences. (a) Formula display at ~index 48818 still reads 'Δg (μGal) = ΔB (nT) / κ, where κ = 1.672 nT/μGal' — should be 1.677 per ISS-2535 suggested_fix. (b) Explanation at ~index 49206 still reads 'κ = 10.9/6.5 = 1.677, rounded to 1.672' — ISS-2535 suggested_fix explicitly says change to just '10.9/6.5 = 1.677'. Creates within-section inconsistency: TLDR says κ = 1.677, body formula says κ = 1.672. The verification_pattern (html.includes('κ = 1.677 nT')) passed because the TLDR landed, but the full find-replace was not completed. Note: the other 1.672 occurrences in part1 at indices 50952, 59307, 59690, 59796 are intentional — quoting dome source code values or documenting the dome's own internal inconsistency — and should remain.
holes_found.proposed_fix: In data/sections.json part1.html: (1) change 'κ = 1.672 nT/μGal' in the formula display paragraph to 'κ = 1.677 nT/μGal'; (2) change 'κ = 10.9/6.5 = 1.677, rounded to 1.672' to 'κ = 10.9/6.5 = 1.677'. Both changes are in the §1.6 'The Law of Aetheric Induction' body.

PARTIAL for ISS-2535: TLDR updated to κ = 1.677; body formula and 'rounded to' text not updated — cross-section standardization incomplete within §1.6 (see Check 3 hole).

check_details.check4_carry_forward: PASS. Prior cycle (part1-ISS2460-2461-verify.c1.json, reviewed_at 2026-06-02T08:30:00.000Z) had 0 holes_found. Nothing to carry forward.
check_details.check5_adversarial: ISS-2534 patched text: 'five Tier-1-class attacks — Aetheric Refraction (1.5), Dielectric Foundation (1.6), Gravity Paradox (1.7), Coordinate Collapse (1.8), and Differential Refraction (1.9)' reads naturally, section numbers in order, §1.6 fits correctly between 1.5 and 1.7, count matches enumeration. ISS-2535 TLDR: 'The coupling constant κ = 1.677 nT/μGal is fitted to one pair of values (not derived from physics)' is clear and well-hedged. However the within-section inconsistency (TLDR 1.677, body formula 1.672) is a casual-reader confusion risk — conflicting values for the same constant within the same section.

summary_for_decider: ISS-2534 fully landed: §1.6 present in both Tier-1 parenthetical (Parts 1.5, 1.6 … 2b) and five-attack enumeration; count correctly updated from four to five. ISS-2535 partially landed: TLDR updated to κ = 1.677 but body formula ('κ = 1.672 nT/μGal') and rounded-to explanation ('rounded to 1.672') not updated — 1 minor hole. Recommend two targeted find-replaces in data/sections.json part1: (1) formula display 1.672→1.677; (2) remove ', rounded to 1.672' from the 10.9/6.5 explanation. Checks 2, 4 clean; no carry-forwards.
